facts: DallasCowboys.com reports that Malik Davis's hip injury ends his 2026 season.
The official team report says Davis required surgery Friday evening.
Dallas says Davis will be placed on season-ending injured reserve.
The formal NFL injured-reserve transaction was not independently verified as completed at retrieval.

sources.author: Nick Eatman
sources.publication_timestamp_note: The page shows its original publication time; its current text reports surgery later that evening and does not expose a separate modified timestamp.

confirmed_vs_speculative.confirmed: The Cowboys' official site reports season-ending hip surgery and planned season-ending IR placement.
confirmed_vs_speculative.analysis: Davis no longer has 2026 redraft contingency value and should be treated as an expendable IR stash.
confirmed_vs_speculative.unresolved: A completed NFL IR transaction and the authenticated Mongo availability of any superior IR-eligible replacement are not yet established.

fantasy_significance: Davis has no expected 2026 redraft production. Emari Demercado's role as the current backup to Javonte Williams is strengthened, but Dallas could still elevate or add another running back.
mongo_relevance: Davis is authenticated as OWNED in JDD's sole IR slot. Keep him there temporarily if the slot would otherwise be empty, but replace/drop him as soon as a meaningful IR-eligible player is authenticated as FREE_AGENT_CONFIRMED or WAIVERS_CONFIRMED. Demercado is already OWNED on the bench and remains a hold.
recommended_action: REPLACE IR STASH WHEN A SUPERIOR IR-ELIGIBLE TARGET IS AUTHENTICATED AS AVAILABLE; HOLD EMARI DEMERCADO; NO LINEUP OR FAAB ACTION NOW

acquisition_target.recommendation: No acquisition recommendation until authenticated ESPN/Mongo availability is established.
